text:
jonathan: Heads up — noticed a spike in SCIM deprovision events for service-account@acme that seems to line up with yesterday's RBAC change + the KMS alias rotation. Anyone seen this?

michelle: Yup. scim.deprovision count jumped ~1.2k in the last hour. Okta logs show a bunch of 403 JWE decrypt errors for batch provisioning.

okta-bot: SCIM batch 729 returned 403 for 12 users. Okta log: https://okta.example.com/logs/req=0a1b2c3d (req_id=0a1b2c3d)

ravi: From the provisioner logs: KMS.Decrypt failing with "InvalidCiphertextException: No matching key found for JWE header". Looks like the provisioner still had tokens encrypted with the old key/alias.

jonathan: Exact error snippet from provisioner: ```ERROR Provisioner: failed to decrypt ext_id payload: InvalidCiphertextException: improper padding or key not found (key-alias:redwood-scim-2026-v2)```

michelle: Can someone check the KMS alias state in prod? Also checksvc:scim-provisioner token cache TTL — maybe it cached ciphertext.

security-eng: Audit timeline: role change (role:scim_provisioner) removed from svcacct:scim-handler at 2026-03-12T22:14Z. KMS alias rotation recorded at 2026-03-12T22:15Z. There's a tight window — likely a race.

jonathan: Proposed immediate steps: 1) re-grant scim_provisioner role to svcacct, 2) revert KMS alias target to previous key material (if allowed), 3) run idempotent backfill to re-encrypt ext_ids and retry failed deprov ops. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

ravi: I can re-grant the role now. Reverting alias needs ops approval from infra. Alternative short-term: bump provisioner to a retry mode that NACKs JWE decrypts into a dead-letter queue for manual backfill so users don't get deprovisioned.

oncall-sre: I'm oncall — will re-add the role and run a small smoke batch. If provisioner still fails, we'll coordinate with infra on alias revert. ETA ~12m.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-482 (priority P2). Playbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/scim-kms-rotation

michelle: Note: when reverting alias we must ensure we don't create duplicate extids. Plan after revert: run Reencrypt job that reads old ciphertext, decrypts with old key, re-encrypts with new key, and atomically swaps extid metadata.

jonathan: Good call. Also add a preflight to rollout: check active long-lived tokens referencing old-keys and pause RBAC edits until re-encrypt completes.

oncall-sre: Role re-added and smoke of 200 accounts ran. SCIM success rate back to normal for that batch. I'll hold off on alias revert until infra gives OK. Monitoring for 30m. :thumbsup:

ravi: After role re-add we see provisioner logs showing successful decrypts for the smoke. Queue drain looks healthy. I still want infra to confirm whether the alias mapping was changed (alias -> new key-id) or if the key material was rotated in place.

security-eng: For postmortem: add checklist for simultaneous RBAC + KMS rotations, add audit alert when SCIM deprov spike > X/min, and add an ordering guard in deploys so key rotation can't be ahead of service rekeying.

michelle: I'll open a follow-up ticket for the backfill + a short runbook update. Thanks all.

jonathan: Thanks team. Closing in on incident; will follow up with a short blameless postmortem once infra confirms alias state. :white_check_mark:
